findings.summary: The build-time Monaco download needs a pinned integrity check, terminating process/cmdlet failures, an atomic version-stamped publish, and shared Monaco.props wiring so clean builds include generated assets reliably.
The FilePreviewCommon project reference should be build-order-only with ReferenceOutputAssembly="false" so RegistryPreviewUILib does not gain an unintended compile/runtime dependency.
The Monaco update instructions must mention updating the pinned package integrity value when pkgVersion changes; otherwise the documented update process will fail the integrity check.
